open.title: Should the basket be kept in local storage or on the server?
open.why: T-14 loses the basket on refresh. Local storage is quick to build; server storage keeps the basket when someone changes device.
open.recommendation: Server storage: baskets then follow people between devices.

open.title: Which sign-in rate limit should we ship?
open.why: T-12 adds rate limiting to sign-in. The three options trade protection against lockouts for people who mistype.
open.recommendation: Five attempts per minute per account: strong enough, and it rarely locks out a real person.

choices.label: 20 attempts per minute per address, none per account
